content: प्रती (प्रति-इ) €2 <ab>P.</ab> .²1 To go back to, return; प्रतीयाय गुरोः सकाशम् <ls>R. 5. 35</ls>; <ls>Bk. 3. 19</ls>. .²2 To go to, approach, turn to. .²3 To fall to the lot of. .²4 To reach, attain. .²5 To believe, trust, be certain or sure of, rely on; कः प्रत्येति सैवेयमिति <ls>U. 4</ls>, <ls n="U.">1. 44</ls>; ततः परशुरामस्य न प्रतीमः पराभवम् <ls>Mv. 2. 14</ls>. .²6 To learn, understand, know, प्रतीयते धातुरिवेहितं फलैः <ls>Ki. 1. 20</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 69</ls>. .²7 To be well-known or celebrated; सोऽयं वटः श्याम इति प्रतीतः <ls>R. 13. 53</ls>. .²8 To be pleased or satisfied; प्रतिः प्रतीतः प्रसवोन्मुखीं प्रियाम् (ददर्श) <ls>R. 3. 12</ls>, <ls n="R.">16. 23</ls>. .²9 To face (an opponent); सहसैन्यानहं तांश्च प्रतीयां रणमूर्धनि <ls>Mb. 5. 172. 13</ls>. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} .²1 To be recognized or perceived. .²2 To be proved, turn out to be true. .²3 To follow from anything (as a necessary result). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (प्रत्याययति) .²1 To cause to believe; convince, inspire confidence; एष विवाद एव प्रत्याययति <ls>Ś. 7</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">5. 31</ls>; ताः खचारित्र्यमुद्दिश्य प्रत्याययतु मैथिली <ls>R. 15. 73</ls>. .²2 To cause to perceive, bring to mind. .²3 To prove, demonstrate, show.
